entities.name: Release assistance indication
entities.description: Information element included by UE to inform the network about expected data transmission patterns, specifically whether no further uplink/downlink data is expected or only a single downlink transmission is expected.

entities.name: No further uplink and downlink data expected
entities.description: Condition where UE indicates no additional uplink or downlink data transmissions are anticipated.

entities.name: Single downlink data transmission expected
entities.description: Condition where UE indicates only one downlink data transmission (e.g., acknowledgement) and no further uplink data is expected after current uplink transmission.

relations.description: Release assistance indication IE can signal the condition of no further uplink/downlink data expected.
Release assistance indication IE can signal the condition of only single downlink data transmission expected.
